content: नासिरम्, -नासीरम् [नासाय ईर्ते ईर् - क <ls>Tv.</ls>] Advancing or fighting in front of an army. .{@-रः@} .²1 The van or front (of an army <ab>&c.</ab>); नासीरचरयोर्भटयोः <ls>Mv. 6</ls>; <ls>N. 1. 68</ls>. नासीरस्थानपि तया पताकाभिरलङ्कृतान् <ls>Parṇāl.</ls> .²2 A champion who advances before the line.
